title: Quran Study from Behrouz 26: Sura 67 and Hamid's Argument with Rashad
source_file: data/sources/playlists/audio-transcripts/26 - Quran Study From Behrouz 1626 Sura 67 By Gatut Hamid Argues With Rashad.csv
document_summary: Gatut leads Sura 67. God possesses all kingship, created death and life as a test, perfected the seven universes, decorated the lowest heaven with stars, and knows every secret thought. The study discusses astronomy, jinn and projectiles, birds, provision, and natural design. The final third becomes a sustained argument between Hamid, Gatut, Rashad, Robert, and others over whether God intervenes in daily events, whether human intelligence and effort have real efficacy, and whether belief in oneself conflicts with belief in God. The recording closes with al-Fatihah for Ali and Farhad.

sections.title: Sura 67:1–2, kingship, omnipotence, death, life, and the test
sections.summary: Gatut explains that all authority belongs to God and that life and death were created to test who performs best. Divine kingship is connected with guidance and the purpose of existence.

sections.canonical_text: Gatut: (We seek) refuge in God from the rejected devil. Bism Allah Arrahman Arraheem In the name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful. We are in Sura 67, Kingship (Al-Mulk). [67:1] Most exalted is the One in whose hands is all kingship, and He is Omnipotent. Well, I have to stop here. The verse says very clearly that in God is all the Kingship. So, Kingship means that He is the sole and the only authority in this whole universe. And He is also Omnipotent according to this verse. We also learn from the Quran that God grants Kingship to whomever He wills, and He grants it to the believers. In other words, we know that people who worship God alone and follow God's commandment alone, God promised them that they will be sovereign, or. kings or queens on earth. In other words, they have everything that they need. Everything that they need will be in their fingertips without, you know, the headache of a celebrity that we know, you know, needs bodyguards, protection from FBI, or you cannot go to Burger King to eat if you want because that's the headache of being a celebrity. You have a prison on your own, but God's servants, the believers, have all this and can still enjoy this, and they have anything that they want. And I think that's the biggest, you know, even the richest person in the world cannot do that because they will go everywhere and everybody or some people or some news reporter will follow them. You know, Sam Donaldson will follow them and ask questions and all that. So, the believers don't have that kind of headache. The same goes with the, you know, financial problems. They don't need 10 million dollars, but they have everything that they need. They get good transportation. They get anything that they need, good clothings, without being, you know, without worrying that the IRS will get into their pocket or something. Gatut: So,... Dr. Khalifa: All the food they can eat. Gatut: All the food that they can eat. That's right. Which is what we have today. Alhamdu Lillah. So, God grants kingship to whomever He wills, and according to the Quran, that is the believers. Verse 2, The Purpose of Our Life. [67:2] The One who created death and life for the purpose of distinguishing those among you who would do better.* He is the Almighty, the Forgiving. God created death and life to distinguish the human beings who are the real believers and who are the wishy-washy ones. We all know that the purpose behind creating us here in this life and the whole universe is because billions of years ago, we doubted God's Supreme Authority. In other words, there is one guy who said "well, I can be a god besides God." And we, all the human beings, this is before the creation of the heavens and the earth and, you know, our stay here, we don't show our firm stand for God. In other words, we said "well, this guy who was Satan, he may have a point." In other words, "let's give him a try. Let's test him." So, we didn't have a firm stand as opposed to the angels, for instance, who said that "there is no way that anybody except God can rule the universe." So, God gave us the second chance to redeem ourselves and this is because of His Mercifulness. God doesn't need to prove anything. He already knew. He knows what's gonna happen. There's no future for Him because as far as He is concerned, everything is past. Everything has taken place. Only He knew it. But we need to affirm to ourselves, in other words, on the Day of Judgment, everybody will see with their own eyes that this is what they do, that they do not really believe or they are a real believer. So, it is the human beings who need the affirmations. So, there'll be no excuses on the Day of Judgment. And verse says that "He is Almighty, the Forgiving." He is Forgiving because even though we committed the blasphemy, we committed the crime that makes us, you know, here in this life right now, He didn't send us outright to Hell, but He gave us a second chance. The angels said, of course, at the time when we were created "why don't You just send them all to Hell?" God says "I know what you do not know." Because God knows that some of the human beings will be redeemed. And these are the believers. Number 3, [67:3] He created seven universes in layers. You do not see any imperfection in the creation by the Most Gracious. Keep looking; do you see any flaw? [67:4] Look again and again; your eyes will come back stumped and conquered. [67:5] We adorned the lowest universe with lamps, and guarded its borders with projectiles against the devils; we prepared for them a retribution in Hell. [67:6] For those who disbelieved in their Lord, the retribution of Gehenna. What a miserable destiny. [67:7] When they get thrown therein, they hear its furor as it fumes. Number 8, [67:8] It almost explodes from rage. Whenever a group is thrown therein, its guards would ask them, "Did you not receive a warner?" [67:9] They would answer, "Yes indeed; a warner did come to us, but we disbelieved and said, 'GOD did not reveal anything. You are totally astray.'" [67:10] They also say, "If we heard or understood, we would not be among the dwellers of Hell!" [67:11] Thus, they confessed their sins. Woe to the dwellers of Hell. Verse number 3, we learn from here that our universe is not the only universe that God created. The scientists, the astronomers, are still trying to determine, you know, the limit or the borders of the universe where we live in. And according to God, and this will be proven, IN SHAA ALLAH, in the near future, that this universe is only one of the seven universes that God created. Dr. Khalifa: (unintelligible) Gatut: Our universe... Dr. Khalifa: (unintelligible) Dr. Khalifa: Go ahead. Gatut: Our universe we live in, we live in the, a little dot called the planet Earth, which is located in the solar system. We have our own star, which is the sun. And our star is one of the hundreds of thousands of stars in our galaxy, which is the Milky Way galaxy. And our Milky Way galaxy is one of the billions of galaxies in the universe that, you know, they stopped counting because they couldn't get the total number. But the universe that we live in, which according to rough calculation is probably about 26 billion light years across, is only the smallest universe. That means that it takes 26 billion years for light to travel. Billions with a B. So, that's how awesome is the innermost universe. And there are six other universes around the innermost universe. And everything is, all the seven universes, according to the Quran, is in God's hand. However, the innermost universe is also, according to verse number five, is actually the prison cell for Satan.

sections.canonical_text: Gatut: [67:13] Whether you keep your utterances secret, or declare them, He is fully aware of the innermost thoughts. [67:14] Should He not know what He created? He is the Sublime, Most Cognizant. This is sort of a rhetorical question. God who created the heavens and the earth and everything in them. Of course, He knows what, you know, what, everything that He created. He's fully aware of all the creation that He made. I mean, in the Quran, there is even a verse that says "not a single leaf falls without Him being knowing all that." So, if we know, if we can count, if it is possible to count how many trees are there in the world and if it is possible to count how many leaves in every tree, which is impossible for any human being, but God knows every single leaf that falls. That is how far, we cannot imagine how great is God. So, we cannot even hide anything from God. You know, the children are usually very very, still very innocent. And they used to be, you know, talk to them about, you know, God and... The best way would be, in my experience, they can lie to you, but we told them that you cannot lie to God. You can lie to your parents, you can lie, but God will always know. So, in the end, they are the ones who keep saying this all the time. God always knows whether we declare anything or we keep it secret. 15. [67:15] He is the One who put the Earth at your service. Roam its corners, and eat from His provisions. To Him is the final summoning. I just read the new translation of the Quran and one of the footnotes, in one of the footnotes, Rashad put the analogy of this earth as a spaceship. So, when NASA launches any spaceship, you know, spaceship with two or three people aboard, they have to calculate exactly how many they're gonna be there, so how much food, how much oxygen, how much water they need. Yet these people are celebrities. These people came back from, you know, from space for a week or two months or whatever, and they came back as celebrities and everybody knew them. You know, they are in the newspaper and everything. Yet God sent us in this spaceship earth, and we are the ones who originally committed sin and, you know, blasphemed against God because we were not sure of God's greatness. Yet God gave us this beautiful spaceship earth with all kinds of provision, not only just food and drink, but also with fuels and all kinds of lakes, mountains, coasts, beaches and all that. And this is because God is the Most Gracious. He's trying to give us a second chance and we have to, you know, we have to...and we know from the scripture, from the Quran, that most people will fail to take the second chance. But yet God gave that in advance and see whether, you know, whether we can appreciate that. Sura... verse 15 says "the earth is put for our service." Everything in this earth is actually put for our service. The animals, the metals, the minerals, the fuel that we can get, anything that we have in this earth is actually created by God for our service. Yet actually we are sinners in the beginning to start with. So, this comparison makes me wonder if a little bit of room in the universe, I mean in the space where these astronauts can climb through and make some celebrities, what about us? God gives us all this for free and we actually are not even celebrities. We are, you know,... Dr. Khalifa: We don't have to wear space suits here. Gatut: Exactly. Dr. Khalifa: We can take a shower in space, too. Gatut: Number sixteen, [67:16] Have you guaranteed that the One in heaven will not strike the earth and cause it to tumble? [67:17] Have you guaranteed that the One in heaven will not send upon you a violent storm? Will you then appreciate the value of My warning? [67:18] Others before them have disbelieved; how terrible was My requital! We know that the earth is such an insignificant mote in God's universe and everything else that is in the universe that God created actually fits the palm of God. Everything, according to God, is in God's hands. So, when a human being looks at a mountain, it's a huge mountain, and they say "this is... "there is no way that anybody can move this." But God says here that nobody can guarantee that nothing will happen to the earth. It's very easy for God, if He wills, to strike the earth, wipe out all the disbelievers, "cause it to tumble" according to this verse. [67:17] Have you guaranteed that the One in heaven will not send upon you a violent storm? ... This is 17. Until now, the weather prediction or weather forecast is still an art. I met one guy who is finishing his PhD in this atmospheric science in the university, and even he considers that weather forecast is still an art. With all the supercomputers that they have, actually weather service is probably one of the biggest agencies that uses supercomputers. They still cannot predict whether it's gonna be rain today or tomorrow in a localized area. Not to mention the global weather pattern. It's still a very difficult subject to deal with. And nobody can guarantee whether this place will get rain with certainty. They cannot, you know, we just... All we need to do is just watch TV and see the weather forecast and how often they make mistakes. So, God can very easily send a violent storm if He wants to. If He decides that somebody needs to be shaken up in this area, then God sends a storm there. Also, the storm actually will fertilize the soil. But all these are warnings, and we should be able to appreciate that. And we learn from history, and the best history is actually the Quran. Because one of the chapters in the Quran is called history. And God says in the Quran that the most important lesson in history, when we study or anybody studies history, is that we know why these things are happening and how to avoid them. Now, we're... We know consistently that anybody or any group or any society who oppose God and His messenger, eventually will be wiped out and eventually will be defeated. So, we know that this happens to the groups of people that came before us. And all are recorded in this word of God that is, not only we know that it's truth, but we have the proof for it, which is the mathematical composition of it. [67:19] Have they not seen the birds above them lined up in columns and spreading their wings? The Most Gracious is the One who holds them in the air. He is Seer of all things. Here God is talking about the law of aerodynamics. We learn from the Khutba today, which is actually one of the, for those who missed the Khutba today, the video program that will be shown starting tomorrow or next week, everywhere is is a very good example of how a 20th century or 21st century human being can appreciate the facts that have been expounded in a book written 1400 years ago. All this detail about everything that only 50 to 100 years ago, some human beings started to learn has been in the Quran for 1400 years. And here we know that, first of all, the birds fly because God decided them to fly using the shape of the wings and the body. And this kind of shape and principle a human being start to learn and then they copy it and they make aeroplanes, they make helicopters with the same principle. In other words, how this 100 tons 747, for instance, can take off into the air. Simply because the shape of the wing is such that when you move the object, there will be less density of the air on top of the wing than below the wing. So, the whole thing will be lifted. So, that's the same design that God has made for the birds' wing. This is the principle of aerodynamics that is not considered well known, but yet all this has been around for millions of years. [67:19] Have they not seen the birds above them lined up in columns and spreading their wings? ... We know that the formation the birds fly, again this is also a principle from aerodynamics. The birds, God teaches the birds to fly in a certain pattern because certain pattern will be the most efficient to reduce the drag. We know that the drag is the biggest challenge for anything that moves in the air. And this kind of formation is now actually being copied by, for instance, if you see Thunderbirds F-16 from the Air Force. They always fly in a certain pattern because that pattern will reduce the drag that each particular plane will experience. Most of us probably know this principle when we drive in the interstate. If you drive 70 miles per hour and there's 18 wheelers 70 miles per hour in front of us, we tend to follow them. Because we're basically having a reduced drag by following them and we can consume... we can conserve more fuel by driving that way. So, that's also a principle of aerodynamics and it's also mentioned in the Quran here. Number 20. [67:20] Where are those soldiers who can help you against the Most Gracious? Indeed, the disbelievers are deceived.
